AttributeList.Text: AdjustStep = 1: Check all the input parameters for LinearityRange and adjustment weights (Hi_Weight, Mid_Weight, Low_Weight, xLow_Weight) AdjustStep = 2: Initializes all the control bits AdjustStep = 3: Write in the LinearityRange into the transmitter (2-byte; Index: 16#400A) AdjustStep = 4: Updates the CurrentPoint and CurrentWeight (new reference weight) and wait for user to trigger ConfirmWeight input bit AdjustStep = 5: Start the adjustment process according to the CurrentWeight (REAL; Index: 16#4009) AdjustStep = 6: After adjusted all the required reference weights, validate the adjustment (2-byte; Index: 16#4010) AdjustStep = 7: Adjustment is completed successfully, set DONE bit to TRUE AdjustStep = 8; Adjustment failed with error, set ERROR bit to TRUE AdjustStep >= 4: Reading the adjustment status continuously (2-byte; Index: 16#4007)
LoadWeight - Inform user to load the next adjustment weight according to CurrentWeight value Process - Status bit to inform that the weight transmitter is performing adjustment process
CANCEL input bit can be triggered any time during the adjustment process to abort. CANCELLED output bit will be set to TRUE after a successful cancellation.
